companies.name: QuadMedicine
companies.description: QuadMedicine is a company with a medical microneedle platform technology that can be applied broadly across transdermally deliverable vaccine pharmaceuticals, synthetic pharmaceuticals, and diagnostic medical devices. Compared to conventional subcutaneous injections or oral medications, the transdermal delivery enabled by QuadMedicine's microneedle platform technology offers advantages such as reduced side effects like gastrointestinal disorders, enhanced patient convenience, and faster drug delivery through high bioavailability.

companies.name: Bitbyte
companies.description: 'PlayKeyboard' is an app that lets users customize their smartphone keyboard with their favorite characters, celebrities, or a wide variety of designs. The standout feature is 'Live Theme,' in which characters or celebrities react or move in response to the keywords being typed — for example, typing 'I love you' causes a character in the keyboard background to send flying hearts, while typing 'lol' displays a laughing motion. Users can also send the motions displayed on the keyboard as GIF emoticons, maximizing the fun and convenience of online chatting and messaging. PlayKeyboard has recorded over 1 million downloads and more than 16 million daily launches, with approximately 35% of all users being organically acquired international users — rapidly growing its user base across 213 countries.

companies.name: H2O Hospitality
companies.description: H2O Hospitality is Asia's leading tech-based hospitality operations company, driving the digital transformation of the accommodation and leisure industry — including hotels and resorts. CEO Lee Woong-hee, who previously operated the home cleaning service 'Wahome' in Korea, pivoted the business to enter the global market. With the goal of organically connecting every step from booking to checkout — previously fragmented and inefficient — through a single click, H2O provides smart check-in and check-out, 100% automated reservations, efficient data control, and D2C expansion services, revolutionizing the operational flow and value chain of accommodation and leisure facilities. The first overseas market H2O entered was Japan, where accommodation revenue alone reaches approximately KRW 90 trillion — roughly ten times that of Korea. H2O entered the Japanese market in January 2017 by acquiring 'Housecare,' a local company connecting cleaning helpers to Airbnb and other short-term rental properties. Targeting a full transformation of the hospitality value chain — from housekeeping and room management to revenue management and reservation management — H2O subsequently acquired 'HospO Alliance,' an online accommodation booking and revenue management system provider, officially marking the start of H2O's full-scale operations. H2O now supplies its services to over 20,000 rooms in Japan and has grown into the largest B2B property management company in the Tokyo area, backed by a track record of managing more than 5,000 staff — particularly notable given Japan's severe labor shortage. Despite the accommodation market downturn caused by COVID-19, H2O has recorded revenue growth of more than twofold since 2021 and is poised to achieve its best-ever results since entering Japan, alongside the recovery of Japan's tourism industry in 2023. Following its entry into Japan, H2O has continued its rapid growth by establishing legal entities in Thailand in 2020, Singapore in 2021, and Saudi Arabia in 2022. In March 2023, it became the first Korean tourism company to sign an MOU with Saudi Arabia's Ministry of Investment for cooperation on market entry, officially launching its full-scale push into the Middle East. It has also opened a regional office in the UAE to oversee its Middle East and European operations. H2O currently operates a cumulative total of 40,000 rooms across 34 major cities worldwide. Recognized for its unparalleled technological capabilities, the company was selected by Forbes Asia as one of the 100 companies to watch in 2021, and became the first in Asia to successfully integrate with Oracle OPERA. H2O's total cumulative investment stands at approximately KRW 48 billion, with major investors including Kakao Investment, KDB Industrial Bank, and Samsung Venture Investment.

companies.name: WantedLab
companies.description: WantedLab is a leading HR tech company whose mission is 'helping everyone work as their true selves and grow with joy.' It provides personalized career growth opportunities through differentiated technology and data, including AI matching. Since its founding in 2015, WantedLab has grown approximately twofold each year and, as of 2023, connects approximately 2.93 million users with 22,000 companies. Its core service is 'Wanted,' an AI matching service that learns from 3 million matching outcome data points, 2.48 million user profiles, and 420,000 company data points to predict the resume pass rate for individual applicants and job postings. Wanted delivers an efficient hiring experience for both applicants and companies, achieving a fourfold increase in resume pass rates and a 70% reduction in time-to-hire compared to traditional recruitment methods. WantedLab also supports individual career growth through 'Career Content' — videos and articles — 'Pre-onboarding,' a company-linked hiring internship program, and 'Community,' a space where users freely exchange information about careers and recruitment. Recently, it launched 'Wanted Gigs,' a service optimized for the evolving freelance market that offers 1:1 dedicated manager support from talent matching through project completion. It has also unveiled 'Wanted Space,' a new HR solution designed to make managing all HR data easy and convenient. In global markets, following its entry into Japan in 2017, WantedLab is operating 'SPOTLIGHT,' an AI-based global recruitment service for English-speaking markets that matches users with personalized job postings. Its strategy involves testing globally built products in worldwide markets and establishing branches or subsidiaries in the markets with the strongest user response — including India, Singapore, and the United States. WantedLab was listed on the KOSDAQ market in August 2021. To support continued growth through strategic investment, it established WantedLab Partners — an investment-focused subsidiary — in 2023, with plans to leverage WantedLab's AI technology to support talent acquisition essential for the growth of high-potential innovative companies and contribute to the success of its portfolio firms.

companies.name: Fescaro
companies.description: Fescaro is an automotive cybersecurity startup developing security technologies that can be applied to actual mass-produced vehicles, including autonomous vehicles and connected cars. Researchers with backgrounds in automotive electronic control unit (ECU) development and security specialists with white-hat hacker experience have come together to build a distinctive security system that overcomes the limitations of conventional network-only security approaches.

companies.name: bemyfriends Co., Ltd.
companies.description: Commerce IP business Logistics SaaS IT-powered global fandom business total solution for artist and brand content IP operations --> bemyfriends is a company based on IT technology expertise that provides 'b.stage' — a total business service solution for artists and brands to facilitate IP business, commerce operations, and sales/marketing. bemyfriends' solution 'b.stage' is a white-label-capable SaaS solution that leverages self-branding to support independent platform construction. By analyzing fandom data generated within the platform, it helps businesses understand fandom needs, maximize IP value, and build sustainable operations.

companies.name: Bitsensing
companies.description: Bitsensing aims to build a safe road infrastructure for the coming era of autonomous driving by integrating RADAR technology into ITS, ADAS, and autonomous vehicle sensors. The company currently provides products and services covering the entire radar technology chain — from radar system design to hardware and software.

companies.name: Gint
companies.description: "Gint is an Ag-Tech company pursuing the advancement of open-field farming through agricultural technology. Gint's autonomous driving kit 'PLUVA auto,' launched in 2022, can be freely attached and detached to tractors, rice transplanters, and riding management machines from major domestic and international brands, helping users track the real-time location data of agricultural machinery. Users can control autonomous driving via a smartphone app or a one-touch switch. Since its launch, approximately 600 sets have been delivered to domestic farms and agricultural institutions, receiving an enthusiastic response from industry professionals. Gint is also conducting research and development on hydrogen tractors, which dramatically reduce carbon emissions in the agricultural sector, and is concentrating on advancing its technology through the convergence of IoT, autonomous driving, and vehicle electronics technology to realize innovation in agricultural productivity. Recognized for its strong technology and market potential, Gint raised KRW 16.5 billion in Series B investment in July 2023, achieving cumulative investment of KRW 25 billion. Based on this investment, Gint plans to begin development of cutting-edge agricultural robot platforms including 'PLUVA Auto Pro,' which can upgrade existing agricultural machinery to Level 3 autonomous operation. The company also plans to expand beyond the domestic market into emerging agricultural machinery markets such as Indonesia and Cambodia, as well as established markets like Japan and Thailand, spreading Gint's advanced agricultural technology worldwide."

companies.name: Equal Table Inc.
companies.description: Equal Table Co., Ltd. is an innovative startup empowering enterprises to quantify and manage carbon emissions across the coffee value chain through its AI-based MRV automation system. As global environmental regulations tighten, sustainability has emerged as a core competitive advantage in the coffee industry. However, the Asian market currently lacks the infrastructure necessary to systematically calculate, manage, and verify emission data. To bridge this gap, Equal Table integrates carbon-reduced coffee with data-driven carbon emission solutions. This unique approach enables corporate clients to seamlessly execute Scope 3 reduction activities and report their performance, ultimately driving a transformative shift toward a transparent and sustainable coffee ecosystem.

companies.name: Danstruct Co., Ltd.
companies.description: Danstruct produces, processes, and sells human movement as standardized 3D motion data (FBX), powered by an end-to-end motion capture and editing pipeline and a dedicated distribution platform. XSTAGE offers a store-like experience for browsing and previewing motions, making it easy for creators and enterprise customers to apply assets across diverse characters and projects. Looking ahead, we are expanding into an AI-powered motion synthesis and editing solution enabling scalable search and library management, and automatically adapting motion data to different character proportions and skeleton setups ultimately reducing production time and cost.
companies.team: Yoon Hye Rin, Oh Sea Ki (CEO)

companies.name: Spring Again Co., Ltd.
companies.description: Operated by Spring Again Co., Ltd., 'NANAS' provides specialized B2B2C mobile solutions for seniors with limited mobility in an increasingly aging society. Its services span across care facilities, silver towns, apartment communities, and private homes, offering specialized on-site care such as beauty treatments, therapeutic foot care, and professional portrait photography. By utilizing its proprietary ERP system for systematic customer history and schedule management, NANAS goes beyond simple beauty services to deliver emotional support and comfort, building a unique ecosystem in the senior care market.

companies.name: Bueno Company Co., Ltd.
companies.description: Bueno Company operates “temply” a solution that enhances marketing efficiency and brand consistency for retail stores while supporting their transition to digital marketing. 'temply' systemizes repetitive and time-consuming promotional tasks, reducing manual workload and enabling stores to manage flyers, POP materials, promotional content, and SMS campaigns within a single system. Powered by design automation technology, 'temply' enables anyone to quickly create high-quality promotional content, improving both operational efficiency and promotional quality at the store level.

companies.name: Polymerize Korea LLC
companies.description: Polymerize is an AI platform built to make industrial R&D faster and more efficient. It brings scattered experimental data into a unified system and uses AI to guide better experiment design and predict potential outcomes, helping teams reduce costly trial and erro. By enabling truly data-driven decision-making, Polymerize lowers research failure costs and accelerates product development. More than a data management tool, Polymerize delivers a “System of Intelligence” that supports the entire R&D workflow from planning to execution.

companies.name: SkyLabs
companies.description: Sky Labs is an AI-driven digital health platform company that provides health monitoring services for the prevention of chronic diseases. By collecting and analyzing patients’ biometric data, the company delivers personalized health management solutions. In particular, Sky Labs offers ring-type medical devices, CART Ring and CART BP, which enable continuous health monitoring without user intervention. These devices allow convenient blood pressure measurement anytime, day or night. The collected data is seamlessly integrated into a connected mobile application, where users can review accurate readings and track changes over time.

companies.name: sparkplus
companies.description: Sparkplus is a shared office company established with the goal of quickly and easily solving office-related problems for all businesses, freeing them to focus on their core work. Starting with its first location at the Yeoksam Aju Building in November 2016, the company opened 34 locations across Seoul and Gyeonggi by the end of 2022, and has since added the Bundang 3rd Location and the COEX location (opening soon) — currently operating a total of 36 locations. The leased area of 125,200㎡ is equivalent to approximately 17.5 international standard soccer fields (7,140㎡ each). Sparkplus' revenue has grown at a steady average of 200% per year since its founding — and grew 13-fold over the five years from 2018 to 2022, successfully turning profitable in 2022. The foundation of this growth lies in the company's agility in responding to market changes and user demand. Sparkplus was the first in the industry to introduce custom offices — allowing clients to use shared office space as if it were their own headquarters — in 2017, and operated a contactless QR visitor management system even before COVID-19. As remote work expanded in the post-COVID era and work styles diversified, the company opened hub offices in key residential centers. In July 2022, Sparkplus also launched the 'SP Workspace' application, based on a QR code-issued 'mobile key card.' The app consolidates all office space-related features into a single interface, enhancing user convenience. Following its KRW 20 billion Series A investment in 2018, Sparkplus raised KRW 30 billion in Series B investment just one year later in 2019 from Aju Hotels & Resorts, Koramco Asset Management, STIC Ventures, and Intervest. In 2021, it secured strategic investment from SK Telecom and Mirae Asset Group.

companies.name: Muzlive
companies.description: Entertainment Developer of KiT, the future-forward music format drawing global attention from artists and fans worldwide --> "Muzlive developed EUC (Encrypted Ultrasonic Communication), an innovative short-range communication technology, through the convergence of breakthrough ideas and IT expertise, and in 2017 introduced KiT — a physical music media format that runs on smart devices. KiT has been recognized as a future-forward music format perfectly aligned with the market trend in which — even as music streaming has become the norm — the number of fans purchasing physical albums has not declined, as owning an artist's album continues to enable the emotional connection between artists and their fans. The KiT Album has released over 350 popular K-pop album titles including BLACKPINK, NCT, and SEVENTEEN, recording sales of 5 million units in the global market and currently in use across 211 countries worldwide. In Korea and globally — including the UK, Australia, and Germany — the KiT Album has achieved the remarkable distinction of being counted as the first new music format since LP, cassette tape, and CD on global music sales charts. In late 2022, global top artists including Jason Mraz, Snoop Dogg, and Weezer released KiT Albums, and the format generated explosive responses at CES 2023 — the world's largest consumer electronics and IT expo — and at SXSW 2023, the largest conference in the United States, drawing massive attention from music industry professionals and artists alike."

companies.name: Queen Live (QUEEN OF SHOPPING)
companies.description: E-commerce The live shopping platform dedicated to women's fashion — Queen of Shopping! --> Queen Live is a women's fashion-specialized live shopping platform founded in 2021. CEO Yoon Jeong-tak uses this app to introduce the latest fashion trends and styles for women in their 40s and 50s, providing a variety of live commerce services. It has grown into one of the standout startups at SparkLabs Demo Day with its innovative services. Queen Live addresses the issues that arose from conducting live commerce within Naver Band — whose primary users are women in their 40s and 50s — by offering Queen Live Web. This provides sellers with sales and settlement management, and consumers with order management solutions.

companies.name: Ssenstone
companies.description: Ssenstone is a company leading the next-generation paradigm in authentication security on the global stage, developing authentication and security technologies to connect institutions, enterprises, and everyday life in a way that is easier, faster, and safer. 'OTAC Token V1.0' is a one-way dynamic token authentication solution built on Ssenstone's proprietary OTAC (One-Time Authentication Code) technology, authenticating users and devices through a one-time dynamic unique identification code. It delivers exceptionally high utility in environments where two-way communication is unavailable, where network conditions are poor or authentication target devices are ultra-lightweight, and in IT/OT environments where ID/password use makes manually changing passwords each time impractical — addressing areas that existing technologies such as PKI and FIDO have not been able to overcome. Ssenstone's unparalleled authentication security technology has already been thoroughly validated across diverse industries at home and abroad. It is deployed and in active use in the financial, defense, and public sectors — where the most sensitive authentication processes are required — including at Toss Bank, KakaoBank, Millie's Pass, and Indonesia's state mint's electronic revenue stamp service. Most recently, Ssenstone successfully completed a first-stage proof of concept (PoC) with LS Electric to proactively block external threats to programmable logic controllers (PLCs), and the two companies continue to collaborate on addressing common global vulnerabilities. Established in London, UK in December 2018, swIDch serves as Ssenstone's global business headquarters and has earned recognition for both its technology and growth potential through prestigious international awards and various accelerator programs around the world. Since taking its first steps through the UK Department for International Trade's (GEP) program and the UK Department for Digital, Culture, Media & Sport's (DCMS) LORCA program, swIDch has been rapidly expanding its business across Europe, the Americas, and Asia. Currently, swIDch is co-developing diverse business models with industry leaders across various sectors, spearheaded by its OTAC (One-Time Authentication Code) technology.

companies.name: RECO
companies.description: RECO is a company that provides optimal waste solutions — from improving waste disposal environments through to resource circulation. 'UpBox,' a total waste collection and transportation service officially launched in 2020, is a comprehensive corporate waste collection and transportation service that professionally manages the entire process — from setting up a site's waste disposal environment, to transportation and data management. A key feature of UpBox is that it precisely measures the volume of waste at each collection, with clients able to check measurement values, environmental indices, and processing progress in real time through the UpBox cloud. UpBox acquired more than 3,000 corporate clients within just three years of launch — the largest client base for a single waste brand. Starting with a focus on food waste in its early days, the service has progressively expanded to include recyclable waste such as plastics and paper, and has accordingly broadened its client base to include businesses that generate diverse types of waste, such as Coupang and Fassto. Maintaining solid growth momentum, RECO raised KRW 14.5 billion in a Series B bridge round in January 2023, recording cumulative investment exceeding KRW 30 billion. On the back of this investment, RECO is currently focused on advancing the UpBox service, while also working to strengthen 'UpBox Cloud,' its waste management software. The company plans to expand UpBox Cloud — previously a client-only software — into a comprehensive circular resource platform encompassing the entire waste value chain, including waste generators, transporters, and processors.

companies.name: WAVE Corp.
companies.description: Entertainment Operator of 'WAVE,' a platform for enjoying games and content together via group video calls --> "WAVE Corporation, based on its vision of 'creating the most fun spaces in the world,' helps people do together online what they would normally do in person offline. 'WAVE,' which lets friends enjoy games and content together during a video call, recreates on mobile the experience closest to meeting friends in person for a great time. WAVE offers more than 15 games popular online — including Mafia, escape room, whack-a-mole, and Gomoku — as well as drawing quizzes, ideal type tournaments, and balance games. Users can also watch videos and webtoon content available on YouTube and Chatie while chatting with friends. WAVE continues to grow rapidly by consistently launching new content that reflects user needs — including 'Shop Together,' which allows friends to online-shop together during a video call; 'Black & White,' a game from the popular broadcast program 'The Genius'; and 'Our Jumbled Korean,' an entertainment-style content experience."

companies.name: DoubleMe
companies.description: DoubleMe was co-founded in March 2015 by Kim Hee-kwan (current CEO), Michael Kuzynski (current COO), and Kim Hee-young (current CFO), and has grown through SparkLabs Accelerator Cohort 5 and Samsung C-Lab. The company has built up immersive capture technology, developing HoloPort — a technology that enables conventional volumetric video capture with a single 3D camera and machine learning — as well as HoloScene, a real-time spatial scanning technology. Leveraging this technology, DoubleMe has expanded globally by forging strategic partnerships with 16 global telecom operators including Telefonica, Deutsche Telekom, and Singtel. DoubleMe's metaverse service platform 'TwinWorld' was also selected as the testbed for 'HoloVerse,' a global project testing 5G mobile edge computing (MEC) network infrastructure. Building on its immersive capture technology, DoubleMe launched the beta service of TwinWorld — a real-world metaverse service — in November 2020, acquiring global users and establishing TwinWorld spaces across 26 locations in 17 cities worldwide, creating and leading a distinct new market called the 'Real-world Metaverse.' Recognized for its unparalleled excellence in core technologies for metaverse platform implementation, DoubleMe has raised KRW 30 billion in investment starting from Series A in 2022, and has been highly evaluated for its growth potential, including signing listing management agreements with NH Investment & Securities and Hanwha Investment & Securities. The company continues to pursue various projects with domestic and international enterprises and institutions.

companies.name: IMPACTUS
companies.description: IMPACTUS is an edu-tech startup transforming personalized education with AI. Our all-in-one platform, Impact Space, supports the full teaching cycle—course creation, delivery, feedback, and assessment. A teacher-facing AI agent structures learning artifacts and assessment evidence generated in class, seamlessly linking them to student documentation. This reduces fragmented administrative work, lowers teacher time burden, and strengthens evidence-based records to mitigate fairness and accountability risks. Built with school-ready operations and management workflows, Impact Space helps schools scale teacher productivity and student growth at the same time.

companies.name: Pierrot Company Inc.
companies.description: Pierrot Company is a circular economy company that transforms used IT devices into global assets and redistributes them across markets. Through its domestic subscription service phoneGO and corporate asset recovery service reGO, the company refurbishes and reallocates devices to extend their lifecycle and structurally reduce electronic waste. Leveraging large-scale pricing and transaction data, Pierrot is developing reGO Trade, an AI-powered price intelligence and trading infrastructure that reallocates underutilized IT assets from developed markets to regions with growing digital demand. Pierrot builds technology-driven circular infrastructure where discarded assets become new opportunities.

companies.name: Kangsters Corp.
companies.description: Kangsters is a social venture founded on deep empathy for the challenges of living with disabilities, dedicated to creating inclusive and innovative technologies for people with mobility impairments. Our flagship product, 'Wheely-X', is a smart treadmill that enables wheelchair users to perform cardio and strength training directly from their own wheelchairs. By connecting with our dedicated app, users can access immersive XR wheelchair racing games and various fitness content, transforming 'tedious rehabilitation' into 'engaging sports'. Furthermore, we are successfully establishing wheelchair racing as an official e-sports category and spreading a 'barrier-free fitness' culture worldwide, breaking down the boundaries between people with and without disabilities.

companies.name: ZEST Inc.
companies.description: ZEST is a climate-tech startup developing an “AI–Digital Twin Converged Pre-construction Agent” for carbon-neutral optimization. In its early stage, ZEST launched “Greenbook,” a green construction material supply chain management platform, through which the company accumulated over 130,000 material data records and established an active user base of more than 100 enterprise clients. Building upon this foundation, ZEST is advancing an integrated digital twin architecture that combines BIM, GIS, and BEM technologies with domain-specific RAG-based AI to automate and optimize decision-making at the design stage. Positioned as a “Geo+AI-based Spatial Digital Twin” company, ZEST addresses both digital transformation and carbon-neutral transition in the construction sector. The company’s primary market strategy focuses on enhancing pre-construction capabilities of small and mid-sized contractors and design firms, with long-term expansion toward the global smart city market.

companies.name: Genoplan
companies.description: Genoplan is a leading company in Korea's genetic analysis market as well as in the Asian genomic information analysis market, including Japan. The company offers a genetic diagnostic kit that analyzes genes from a single saliva sample to reveal a wide range of health data, and provides services to a diverse range of domestic and international clients — including insurance sales companies seeking to design personalized products, pharmaceutical companies aiming to reduce new drug development costs and improve efficacy using genetic data, and cosmetics firms. Genoplan has also achieved commercialization in Asian markets including Japan and Indonesia. As data — alongside artificial intelligence — has emerged as the most critical factor in population genomics, Genoplan aims to integrate genomic data from Far East Asia including Korea, as well as Southeast Asian countries such as Indonesia and Thailand, to address the inequality in genomic data currently skewed toward Europeans and open a future where anyone can access and utilize their own genetic information. Recognized for the excellence of its deep learning-based polygenic risk score technology for disease prediction and its NGS-based expanded carrier screening technology, Genoplan was selected for the '2022 Korea AI Startup 100 Project.' Genoplan has recently developed an AI model integrated with NGS technology to build a prediction model covering rare genetic variants, for which it has filed a patent. Going forward, the company plans to advance genomics beyond disease diagnosis to enable prediction of future disease risk even in healthy individuals.

companies.name: MBX
companies.description: Memebox (MBX), a global multi-beauty brand and personal care startup, operates an e-commerce platform featuring over 4,000 beauty brands worldwide. Its in-house makeup brand 'I'M MEME' has gained popularity among K-beauty fans both domestically and internationally. Memebox became the world's first company to co-develop two brands — 'KAJA' and 'JOAH' — with Sephora, the world's leading cosmetics retail chain. KAJA by Memebox ranks as the top preferred brand among Sephora's Gen Z customers. Since its founding in 2012, Memebox became the first Korean startup to receive investment from Y Combinator, and has since raised cumulative investments exceeding KRW 200 billion from JJD, Formation Group, Goodwater Capital, Altos Ventures, and others.

companies.name: havehad
companies.description: Havehad is a lifestyle brand that caters to people who embrace and enjoy diverse urban lifestyles, delivering refined and inspiring products that bring fresh perspective to everyday life.

companies.name: obzen
companies.description: Obzen is an AI solutions company that develops enterprise software based on AI and data science technologies. Centered on its core AI CRM solution, the company integrates with major enterprise systems such as ERP and SCM to collect, consolidate, and analyze customer data, enabling optimized business insights and personalized services.

companies.name: kokozi
companies.description: kokozi is a kids audio-tech startup that operates a platform providing interactive auditory stimulation for infants and toddlers both online and offline through “Cocozzi House” and its character-based audio content, “Arti.”

companies.name: Allganize
companies.description: Allganize is a company that provides “Alli,” an enterprise AI solution that automates AI deployment in an immediately executable form based on a company’s real operational data.

companies.name: GAPT
companies.description: GAPT is a carbon-neutral, ESG-focused company selected for Korea’s national carbon neutrality and green growth program, Net Zero Challenge X. The company possesses comprehensive technologies and equipment for reducing semiconductor specialty gases and air pollutants, and is expanding its carbon-neutral CCUS greenhouse gas reduction technologies through pilot implementations at institutions and large-scale industrial sites. By securing advanced gas treatment technologies, GAPTECH provides an integrated gas treatment system capable of handling both low- and high-concentration gases, delivering end-to-end solutions for greenhouse gas reduction.

companies.name: Shutagen
companies.description: Shutagen is a manufacturing digital transformation engineering company that defines on-site industrial challenges and delivers solutions to achieve business agility across various manufacturing sectors, including automotive, shipbuilding and offshore, defense, and steel industries.

companies.name: GELKO
companies.description: GELKO is a company that manufactures automated softgel capsule production equipment, seamless softgel capsule production systems, and AI-based vision inspection machines.

companies.name: Slowave
companies.description: Slowave is developing Slowave 1.0, an ultra-compact EEG analysis device designed to support mental health diagnosis and improvement by analyzing sleep and brainwave data—fundamental vital signs of mental health in an era where mental well-being is becoming as important as physical health. Starting with sleep, Slowave is positioning itself as a company that provides clinicians with objective biometric data to support the diagnosis and treatment of conditions such as delirium, ADHD, and cognitive disorders, while helping patients improve their overall mental health.

companies.name: LEHOSAH
companies.description: LEHOSAH is a tech-driven jewelry company operating CHROMAKEY, an AI-powered jewelry design automation platform built on 40 years of manufacturing expertise and a database of over 400,000 CAD files. The platform automates the entire process from design concept to 3D CAD generation using sketch or text inputs, and the company operates both B2B jewelry manufacturing services and the B2C jewelry brand MSGRN based on this technology.

companies.name: Beamstudio
companies.description: Beam Studio is a creative tech company specializing in digital human content production and digital human IP agency services. Through its proprietary solution, BeamRealSolution, Beam Studio delivers high-end digital human content for films and broadcast productions, including TV dramas. The company is also building a digital human IP agency focused on well-known figures such as actors, artists, and sports stars. companies.name: Peaches

companies.name: KnowRe

Leading Korean game companies including Sunday Toz, Gamevil, and Road Complete use the 5Rocks tool.

companies.name: Zoyi
companies.description: Zoyi Corporation used its proprietary sensors alongside visitors' Wi-Fi and Bluetooth signals to bring customer analytics — previously available only in e-commerce — to offline retail businesses. companies.name: Landing International

companies.name: Chartmetric

Chartmetric is a service that compiles and displays the music and performance activities of 2 million music artists worldwide in an at-a-glance dashboard. It tracks 1.5 million songs daily and aggregates 15,000 charts. Its client base includes legacy labels such as Universal Music, Sony Music, and Warner Music, as well as streaming services like Amazon, Apple, and Google. Since its launch in June 2016, the service has grown to annual revenue of USD 2 million as of 2021. Chartmetric tracks in real time nearly every platform on which music is available. For example, selecting BTS displays the rankings and fluctuations of that artist across global music charts — from the Billboard charts to Korea's Melon — in graph form. It also shows follower count changes and qualitative and quantitative growth within follower bases across social platforms such as Instagram, YouTube, and TikTok. As a dashboard service, Chartmetric is intuitive and enables real-time tracking and analysis of popularity trends — including the gender, ethnicity, and age breakdown of a specific artist's fanbase, and fandom changes driven by particular concerts or events — all viewable at a glance. companies.name: TreePlanet
companies.description: TreePlanet is a social venture that develops forest-creation products enabling tree planting through a variety of methods, offered to citizens, corporations, and government agencies. Its goal is to plant 100 million trees worldwide by 2050. Since co-founders Kim Hyung-su and Jung Min-chul established the company in 2010, TreePlanet has planted 1.1 million trees around the world, working alongside the strategy and marketing teams of diverse global companies to develop three-to-five-year environmental conservation campaign strategies — mobilizing 1.2 million participants in forest-creation efforts. Key initiatives include the 'Companion Tree' adoption program — where purchasing one plant results in another being planted in a forest — and the 'Classroom Forest' program, which creates indoor forests inside elementary school classrooms to reduce fine dust levels and support children's emotional development. Using the revenue generated from these programs, TreePlanet has partnered with the Eastern Regional Forest Service since January 2018 to restore forests damaged by wildfires, participating in the planting of approximately 120,000 trees and forest restoration in wildfire-affected areas across Gangneung, Donghae, and Samcheok. In 2020, it launched a project together with the Korea Forest Service, SK Forestry, and the Ethiopian government to support Ethiopian coffee-farming households and build sustainable farms — an international development cooperation initiative conducted as part of the 'P4G Initiative,' a coalition of mid-sized nations across continents committed to green growth and the Global Goals 2020. As ESG (Environmental, Social, and Governance) factors become increasingly central to corporate management and carbon neutrality is set as a national goal, TreePlanet is proposing projects tailored to each industry sector for major global companies and public institutions worldwide, pursuing long-term, sustainable partnerships.

companies.name: Piquant
companies.description: Piquant is a specialist company in spectroscopy-based component analysis solutions. It develops systems providing precise and near-real-time analysis and monitoring of air quality, water quality, skin condition, and other areas — including fine dust — using IoT, AI, and Big Data. Piquant developed a technology to measure bacteria in water in near-real time, making it the first Korean company to secure a partnership agreement and research and business funding from the Bill & Melinda Gates Foundation. In 2020, it became a foundation partner in the water and sanitation improvement sector. In 2022, it passed the Foundation's second support program and received approximately KRW 900 million in funding. It currently exports to India's Ganges River management authority, Vietnamese nonprofits, and UNICEF.

companies.name: Lockin Company
companies.description: Lockin Company's mobile app security solution LIAPP is a no-code SaaS security service that applies protection simply by uploading a completed app, with no additional coding required. It has gained popularity by offering annual and monthly subscription plans, allowing users to purchase and use the product according to their preferred billing period. LIAPP is a Runtime Application Self-Protection (RASP) solution that provides robust security for mobile apps, alerting security teams and users to threats detected outside the system to prevent attacks. It offers a wide range of cybersecurity services including rooting and jailbreak detection, debugging and tampering prevention, in-app memory and native library protection, as well as remote control blocking and screen capture prevention to effectively guard against fraud in the financial sector. App administrators can also monitor threats in real time via a dashboard, enabling companies running mobile app services to effectively defend against app hacking. Founded in 2013, Lockin Company is a cybersecurity services specialist whose LIAPP solution is widely used across Korea, Japan, the United States, Singapore, Vietnam, Thailand, Indonesia, Austria, and Brazil. Notably, Lockin Company has been recognized by Gartner as a representative application security vendor and was designated as an 'Outstanding Information Security Technology Product' by the Ministry of Science and ICT. In March 2023, the company also won Gold Awards in three categories — 'Application Security,' 'Mobile Application Security,' and 'Runtime Application Self-Protection' — at the Cybersecurity Excellence Awards.

In 2018, it launched the Aergo mainnet and continues to develop blockchain solutions that enable a wide range of users, from enterprises to the general public, to leverage blockchain technology. Blocko has independently developed both AERGO Enterprise and the AERGO mainnet, and as a blockchain MSP company focused on the practical application of blockchain technology, it is continuously releasing and testing a variety of new features and services. Blocko's technology and future potential are recognized not only in Korea but also in the UK, the Middle East, and the United States. As the first MSP company in Korea to receive an 'A' rating in a mock technology special listing evaluation for KOSDAQ, Blocko has had its technological capabilities verified by the Ministry of Science and ICT and the Korea Internet & Security Agency (KISA).

companies.name: Water Strider
companies.description: Water Strider is a company holding core technology in 3D proximity spatial sensing and has developed contactless solutions through field variation detection. In 2021, it established a joint venture with Sensorview, a specialist in 5G cables and antennas. As sustained interest in personal hygiene grew amid the ongoing COVID-19 pandemic, Water Strider has been developing contactless door switches, elevator buttons, and similar products by integrating its proprietary solutions to operate switches from close range without direct physical contact. The company also plans to expand its business into premium product lines utilizing advanced 3D spatial touch technology and mass-market mobile communication devices through further technological advancement.

companies.name: S.Lab Asia
companies.description: S.Lab Asia is a leading pharmaceutical cold chain specialist company in Korea. It achieved the top market share in the domestic COVID-19 vaccine container market and contributed to the transport of vaccines covering approximately 70% of the total doses administered nationwide. Building on Greenie Medi — its pharmaceutical cold chain packaging — the company has also launched TTL, a real-time temperature measurement data logger, and a cloud-based TTL Platform. Through these innovations, S.Lab Asia is working to realize SCM Visibility for pharmaceuticals and food products.

companies.name: Bringko
companies.description: E-commerce Bringko (item mall enabling convenient overseas purchases from Korea's major open markets, large shopping malls, and item stores) --> Bringko is Korea's first reverse-purchasing meta service, helping overseas Korean communities conveniently purchase products from any shopping mall in Korea.

companies.name: xSync
companies.description: xSync is an event platform that provides interactive features enabling attendees at offline events to network with each other and participate in event activities. Event organizers have long needed a mobile web or application that could efficiently deliver information and facilitate networking — yet building one has traditionally been difficult and costly. Drawing on the CEO's experience as a live performance director, xSync has modularized the features needed for events, making it possible to create a dedicated event app in just a few clicks at a reasonable price. Even after an event concludes, xSync can measure the success of the event through data, including user feedback collection. To date, xSync has served over 500,000 users across approximately 500 events.

companies.name: Balaan
companies.description: Balaan is the fastest-growing luxury commerce platform in the market, solving the problems of Asia's massive KRW 150 trillion luxury goods market through supply chain innovation and IT integration. Through contracts with carefully selected domestic suppliers and overseas boutiques, Balaan distributes the widest variety of brand products in Korea, and its optimized distribution system delivers locally sold items to Korean customers within just three days. Balaan CEO Choi Hyung-rok founded Balaan in 2015 after visiting luxury multi-brand boutiques in Europe and getting the idea to offer their affordable and diverse product selection as an online service in Korea. Despite active data-driven logistics innovation across the fashion industry as a whole, the luxury goods markets in Korea and broader Asia lacked precise data relative to their scale. Balaan capitalized on its ability to digitize the Korean luxury market — which, though smaller than China and Japan, is a trendsetter in fashion — to attract overseas luxury boutiques and brands to its platform. Balaan plans to enhance the customer experience through an omni-channel combining online and offline touchpoints, provide integrated logistics services to domestic retailers, and revolutionize the entire value chain of Korea's luxury distribution market. Alongside this, the company is advancing its data and IT-driven e-commerce infrastructure and pursuing innovation across the full luxury shopping experience that customers seek — targeting a luxury lifestyle super app. Balaan's transaction volume grew rapidly from KRW 25.7 billion in 2019, to KRW 53.3 billion in 2020, KRW 315 billion in 2021, and KRW 680 billion in 2022. The compound annual growth rate over the past four years stands at 127%. As of 2022, Balaan's market share in Korea's approximately KRW 1.5 trillion online luxury market is estimated at approximately 45%. In April 2023, Balaan raised KRW 25 billion in Series C investment, bringing its total cumulative investment to KRW 73.5 billion.

companies.name: XBrain
companies.description: XBrain helps people who lack professional experience and knowledge in machine learning to leverage it with ease. Machine learning technology remains underutilized across many areas of daily life due to a range of barriers — including a shortage of expert personnel and complex machine learning software. XBrain's goal is to lower these barriers through 'Alice,' the solution it provides, and make machine learning accessible to everyone.

companies.name: FASKET
companies.description: FASKET, a neighborhood delivery market, is a milk-run quick commerce service that aggregates both online products and popular items from local restaurants, delivering them all together to buyers within one hour.

companies.name: Collegenie AI
companies.description: EssayFit AI implements the evaluation methods of former Ivy League admissions officers using GPT, providing US college applicants with a trustworthy, professional AI tutor responsible for reviewing their admissions essays and guiding their overall application process.

companies.name: Noda Labs
companies.description: Others Data Analytics Operating the big data-based B2B trade platform 'KFoodBuyers' to provide Korean market analysis data to overseas food suppliers --> Noda Labs is a data analytics company founded in 2020, providing analysis of the Korean food market to overseas food suppliers through 'KFoodBuyers', a big data-based B2B trade platform. The platform helps overseas suppliers find buyers suited to the Korean market, and has recently expanded to include online one-stop trade transaction functionality. Noda Labs' vision is to contribute to building a safe trade market and fostering a healthy import ecosystem.

companies.name: Bootalk(Uiti)
companies.description: 'Bootalk' is a proptech startup founded in 2016, providing AI-powered personalized real estate listing recommendation services. The company collaborated with Seoul National University's GIS·LBS Lab to develop AI-based real estate spatial reasoning technology, and has been certified as an excellent real estate service provider by the Minister of Land, Infrastructure and Transport. Going forward, the company plans to enhance voice input-based property search functionality and expand its platform services to office and commercial property brokerage.

companies.name: Careerday
companies.description: CareerDay is an HRtech platform that precisely matches professionals and companies across diverse fields, from IT and finance to bio and semiconductors. Demonstrating remarkable growth since its founding, it leads innovation in the HR sector and aims to provide the best experience for both employers and job seekers through a customized recommendation system and proprietary algorithms.

companies.name: StandingTall
companies.description: Founded in 2014, StandingTall is a Korean healthcare company specializing in the manufacture and sale of the spinal brace 'FlexPine'. In 2023, the company expanded beyond the domestic market through exports to enhance its competitiveness, participating in the 'FIME' medical device exhibition in Florida, USA. Additionally, in 2022, StandingTall received the 'HCPCS CODE' in the United States, enabling local purchase reimbursement support.

companies.name: Instant Tattoo
companies.description: Instant Tattoo is Korea's first dry temporary tattoo brand, reproducing the vibrancy of a real tattoo in just 10 seconds. Through a vivid color palette and delicate matte texture, it perfectly expresses the original designs of renowned artists from Korea and around the world. Your first special tattoo experience that adds a touch of sparkle to the dull everyday urban life — that is Instant Tattoo.

companies.name: StarTeacher (TEvalueWise)
companies.description: The service launched in September 2017 with the first-ever provision of information on civil service exam instructors in Korea. By September 2018, it had expanded to a site that provides evaluation information on hundreds of thousands of instructors and tens of thousands of institutions — covering not only civil service exam instructors but also university professors, English and foreign language tutors, certification exam instructors, and kindergarten teachers.

companies.name: Tella
companies.description: Tella is an on-demand English conversation education service where learners receive real-time chat lessons and corrections from professional native speaker instructors via messaging. Using Google's natural language processing technology, the service analyzes learners' English chat data to diagnose their English usage patterns and proficiency levels, and provides personalized learning content.

companies.name: Xelin
companies.description: Semiconductors are becoming smaller, thinner, and more multi-layered as their applications evolve — yet conventional semiconductor processing methods face limitations including heat generation, particle control issues, and the inability to control depth. Xelin's Micro-Dicing laser cutting technology overcomes these limitations, providing a solution that enables cutting without material damage.

companies.name: Spiceware
companies.description: Spiceware is a startup aimed at providing a security platform to protect the systems and critical data of cloud computing users. By applying an encryption method that improves upon the drawbacks of conventional database encryption solutions that are difficult to implement in cloud environments, Spiceware eliminates wasted time and capital associated with data encryption. It also provides a solution with the capability to apply multiple encryption keys and to integrate monitoring and management of dispersed in-house data through a single security platform.

companies.name: Whelp
companies.description: Whelp is a platform that helps sales and customer support teams communicate with customers who use different messaging channels — all in one place. Companies currently use more than six different communication channels at once to engage with customers, making it difficult to log and manage all customer conversations in one place. Whelp integrates all communications — including phone calls, text messages, email, and social media — into a single, unified management hub. It also integrates invoicing technology and payment gateways, enabling all sales and customer support processes to be handled within a single application.

companies.name: Paywatch Global
companies.description: Paywatch is a one-stop HR service platform that handles the hiring and contracting of hourly workers, attendance approval management, and real-time payroll calculation and disbursement. Through blockchain technology, HR-related information for each worker is efficiently recorded and managed — enabling employers to easily track each employee's contract details and work records, while workers can check their hours and pay in real time and receive payment immediately. This minimizes disputes between employers and workers, and helps prevent wage withholding.

companies.name: Caredoc
companies.description: Caredoc is a user-tailored platform that intermediates elderly care services and care facilities based on information verified through government agency evaluations and real user reviews. As Korea enters a full-scale aging society, demand for nursing services and care facilities is exploding alongside the growing elderly population. However, consumers struggle to find highly reliable information or facilities suited to their individual circumstances, while providers face difficulties in attracting clients. Caredoc enables comparison of care providers based on data from approximately 20,000 elderly care facilities nationwide and 35,000 facility evaluation data points, and allows users to select the most suitable care provider through a personalized recommendation system tailored to individual circumstances such as budget and health condition. Additionally, through fee-free care facility brokerage, Caredoc enhances the convenience of both consumers and facilities alike.

companies.name: Featuring
companies.description: Featuring is a platform that measures the 'real' influence of social media influencers. While diverse brands run various types of marketing campaigns through influencers, they are wasting budgets due to the problem of fake followers and fake engagement on influencer accounts. Featuring collects 250,000 activity data points from social media influencers on Instagram, YouTube, and other platforms every day, and provides brands with a 'Featuring Score' — an influencer impact score — along with detailed reports generated through machine learning and natural language processing analysis. Through Featuring, brands can identify the right influencers without wasting campaign budgets, and carry out the entire process — from searching and matching to running campaigns — as a self-service.

companies.name: SmartJack
companies.description: Lab Manager is a laboratory management solution. Most laboratories are still managed the same analog way as decades ago — with handwritten ledgers and manual record-keeping. Lab Manager resolves the resulting inefficiencies in time and cost, as well as the risks of safety incidents. By reading text and QR codes on reagent labels, Lab Manager automatically inputs complex information and shares the current status in real time via PC and smartphone. It manages the entire lifecycle of reagents — from purchase, registration, and use through to disposal, and back to purchase again. Lab Manager is currently used in laboratories at over 500 universities and government-funded research institutions including KAIST and Korea University, and is expanding its services to include a reagent purchasing platform and a laboratory work messenger.

companies.name: Activity Exchange
companies.description: AX (Activity Exchange) is a startup developing travel product publishing and reservation management solutions for local travel agencies worldwide. Through the AX solution, local travel agencies can publish travel products to dozens of online sales channels simultaneously and manage reservations coming in from all sales channels in real time via the app. AX provides an integrated solution that enables travel agencies — which previously managed products and bookings with spreadsheets — to increase revenue and reduce costs.

companies.name: Global Bridge
companies.description: Global Bridge is a company holding proprietary binary CDMA technology that enables large-volume data transmission with guaranteed security. The company holds core technologies and patents in security algorithms and wireless data transmission and reception devices, and is currently in the process of securing reliability and commercializing its products through pilot installations across the country. Going forward, Global Bridge plans to provide a wide range of wireless communication solutions across areas including public safety and disaster monitoring, unmanned robotics, defense, shipbuilding, and Korea Electric Power Corporation's (KEPCO) wireless remote meter-reading project (AMI).

companies.name: Thirteenth Floor
companies.description: Thirteenth Floor aspires to become the Netflix of VR. The company possesses the production capability to create both world-class cinematic and interactive VR content, along with immersive audio expertise and a fully in-house production pipeline. Through technology integration, it generates powerful synergies between cinematic VR and interactive VR, and retains most of the content it produces as its own IP — expanding its influence in the global VR content market. Thirteenth Floor is backed by a strong team that includes content specialists, platform experts, and software engineers with backgrounds at Naver, CJ, and Nexon.

companies.name: Simple Kitchen (HAT Company)
companies.description: Simple Kitchen is a shared kitchen platform that provides restaurant entrepreneurs with kitchen space and facilities, and enables cost-sharing across various expenses — reducing overhead while maximizing revenue. Through expert-backed consulting, Simple Kitchen resolves the design, complex paperwork, and menu development challenges that arise during the early stages of starting a business. It also directly contributes to revenue generation through group purchasing, regular delivery arrangements, and catering service sales — maximizing the chances of entrepreneurial success.

companies.name: Fleapop
companies.description: Fleapop is a retail tech company. It currently provides Experience Commerce for women in their teens and twenties, with over 30,000 customers visiting per two-day event. Fleapop is applying IT technology to Experience Commerce to expand it into an optimized crossover shopping channel.

companies.name: Emolize (payvil)
companies.description: Emolize Co., Ltd. is a fintech company established to provide international payment services. The company operates the Payvil app service, currently enabled for payment at 12,000 stores in Korea. Payment is processed through Alipay under a partnership agreement. Plans are underway to launch services in Japan and Taiwan within the year. Emolize aims to grow into a company that provides affordable and secure payment services to all foreign visitors to Korea, as well as Korean travelers visiting China, Taiwan, and Japan.

companies.name: Kadho
companies.description: Kadho is a brain training curriculum specialist company that combines the latest research in neuroscience with knowledge in artificial intelligence and machine learning to accelerate the acquisition of specialized skills. The company develops and distributes interactive consumer products designed to enhance individual performance. It currently offers services in sports and language acquisition, with established partnerships with MLB, NHL, U.S. Olympic teams, and top sports programs at various universities. In the area of language acquisition, Kadho focuses on improving English learning efficiency through neuroscience, leveraging deep learning-based bilingual educational toys and learning apps.

companies.name: The Clozet
companies.description: The Clozet is a fashion sharing service that aspires to be the Airbnb of fashion. It connects individual customers to let them earn income by sharing fashion items they rarely use, while enabling others to conveniently rent fashion items at reasonable prices. It also differentiates itself through a professional concierge service covering delivery, dry cleaning, and item care. Starting with luxury designer brand handbags, the company plans to expand into the full range of fashion categories.

companies.name: Asian Boss
companies.description: Asian Boss is a new media company delivering the latest news and trends from across Asia to the world. Through a mobile-optimized report format and a distinctive street interview style, it is developing an innovative news format that conveys diverse social issues across Asia and the candid perspectives of people on those issues. Currently it has secured over 400,000 subscribers and followers on YouTube and records an average of 6 million views per month.

companies.name: Kloser
companies.description: Marketing Kloser (customer channel management platform) --> Kloser is a marketing tech specialist company that delivers a customer channel management platform via the cloud. The most effective and trusted promotional channel is the voice of the customer, and Kloser is the tool for managing customers as that channel. Kloser provides a wide range of features to facilitate the sharing of customer experiences — whether through a company's website, app, physical store, or product — onto customers' social media, and tracks and measures the results from sharing through to response, traffic, and purchase on an individual basis. It also accumulates customer experiences as a brand's digital content assets and secures influential customers as dedicated channels. In Korea, companies including Hyundai Motor Company, SK Telecom, SK Fashion, as well as theme parks, liquor brands, duty-free shops, luxury goods retailers, and shopping mall operators have been using Kloser for several years. Since 2016, WeChat-based Kloser — offered through a Chinese subsidiary — has been adopted by luxury goods, cosmetics, and marketing companies in China.

companies.name: QueensBucket
companies.description: QueensBucket is a manufacturer that produces the sesame oil and perilla oil we have grown up eating, using a completely different production method from conventional approaches. QueensBucket's oils are far closer in taste and aroma to the traditional flavors of old — much more so than machine-pressed oils — and are roasted at low temperatures using far-infrared rays to minimize the generation of harmful substances. A cold-press extraction method is also used to maximize the preservation of various vitamins, enzymes, biological agents, and trace elements. The oil is filtered one additional time through a pharmaceutical-grade filter made from pure natural materials and bottled immediately, eliminating any unnecessary oxidation in the process. The result delivers a vibrant aroma and deep nuttiness that provides a remarkable sensory experience.

companies.name: Paymonths
companies.description: Paymonths, developed by Finoverse Lab, is Korea's first Buy Now Pay Later (BNPL) service utilizing machine learning-based credit scoring.

companies.name: Urbanbase
companies.description: Founded in 2014, Urbanbase is a 3D spatial data specialist company that possesses core modeling technology for automatically converting 2D blueprints into 3D, as well as key technologies in metaverse domains such as virtual reality (VR) and augmented reality (AR). Urbanbase's business areas include an integrated interior platform called 'Urbanbase' — handling everything from 3D interior simulation to actual construction services on a single platform — and B2B services in the form of SaaS and API/SDK that enterprise clients ranging from Shinsegae Casa, Iloom, and ACE Bed to sole proprietors and SMEs can select according to their implementation environment. Recognized for its market potential and technological prowess, Urbanbase entered the Japanese market in 2019. Following Japan's top furniture company 'Nitori', it has continued to lead the digital transformation of Japan's interior industry by providing 3D interior services to prominent companies including SoftBank — Japan's largest IT company — and commercial real estate firm At Office in 2022.
